title.en: Watashi no Fiancé wo Ubatta Danshaku Reijou ga Naze ka Natsuite Kimasu - Uruwashi no Reijou ♂ no Hakarigoto
Kokoro wo Tozashita Koushaku Kakka to Konyaku Shita Hazu na no ni, Naze ka Taisetsu ni Sasete Shimattemasu!
Meryoku no nai Otaku Reijou wa, Jiki Koushaku-sama no Ichizu na Dekiai ni Honrousareru
Itsuwari no Hanayome Reijou to Kieta Kaichuudokei
Yuusha ni Uragirareta Tensei Chiyuushi ga Maou no Chouki ni Naru Made
Imouto ni Kon'yakusha o Yuzure to Iwaremashita: Saikyou no Ryuu ni Kiniirarete Masaka no Oukoku Nottori?
Lens-goshi, Tatta Ichido no Koi wo suru - Shissou Reijou to Cameraman
Fuguu no Reijou wa Kitai no Hikari Mahoutsukai ni Misomerare Hanahiraku
Urareta Henkyou Haku Reijou wa Ringoku no Outaishi ni Dekiai Sareru
Ouhi-sama ga Otoko da to Kidzuita Watashi ga, Zenryoku de Inpei Kousakusasete Itadakimasu!
Dare ni mo Aisarenai no de Yuka wo Migaite Itara Soko ga Seiiki-ka shita Reijou no Hanashi
Shinitakunai no de, Zenryoku de Kobitara Dekiaisaremashita!
Konyakusha ga Uwaki shite Iru you Nandesu kedo Watashi wa Hayari no Akuyaku Reijou tte Koto Deattemasu ka?
"Kuji" kara Hajimaru Konyaku Seikatsu ~Gensei naru Chuusen no Kekka, Warawanai Jiki Koushaku-sama no Konyakusha ni Tousen shimashita~
